answer: Reaching the bridge of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, revoked by a single upheld challenge. The lotus lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the quill is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
